**Where it opens**
- The **Inventory** button at `game-console.component.html:9` calls `openInventory()` (`frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts:237`).
- That calls `MatDialog.open(InventoryComponent, …)` with `panelClass: 'inv-dialog-panel'` and `maxHeight: '90vh'` (`:242-246`). I read this part in the code.

**Data passed**
- The data is `InventoryDialogData = { characterId: this.characterId, sessionId: this.sessionId }`. The interface is at `inventory.component.ts:19`.
- The dialog gets it through `inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA)` (`inventory.component.ts:41`).

**API calls the dialog can make**

All of these go through `GameApiService` (`frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts`).

| Action | Component method | Service method | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|---|
| Load on init | `ngOnInit` (`:53`) | `getInventory` (`:90`) | `GET /api/character/:id` (`routes/character.ts:72`), mapped to `{ inventory }`. The result is also copied into `CharacterStateService.setInventory`. |
| Equip or unequip | `toggleEquip` (`:72`) | `equipItem` (`:96`) | `PATCH /api/character/:id/equip` (`routes/character.ts:93`) |
| Drop | `dropItem` (`:144`) | `dropItem` (`:100`) | `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` (`routes/character.ts:137`). It asks for `confirm()` first and removes one unit. |
| Use potion | `usePotion` (`:96`) | `dropItem` | The same `DELETE` as drop. The potion is consumed this way. |

**Caveats**
- The three `GameApiService` shop and quest methods aren't used by this dialog. The shop endpoints (`/api/shop/:id` and `/api/shop/transaction`) exist in the Worker but have no UI.
- Potion healing is rolled in the browser, and HP is only set locally (`:110-129`). It is never saved to the Worker (B-05).
- Equipping is display only, because combat ignores equipment (B-08).
- The dialog opens at the bottom of the page because `styles.scss` lacks `mat.core()` (B-14).

I took the details from `docs/flows/inventory.md` and `docs/code/frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.md`. Only the `openInventory` code was checked against the source.
